visual_name: Day in the life, part eleven: how many followers (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js living room at dusk, box-built character and cat, application / forms / leaderboard pages, profile and follower-shop phone pages, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.6 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a brand's first question is her follower count, two thousand is too small, every form wants a media kit, her cat has more followers and she nearly buys some; then YourBrand: every campaign has a leaderboard ranked by views, not followers. The cat is not on the leaderboard and pushes her mug off the table.
